channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: Starmer meets Xi: Is the world order being rewritten – or written off?
item.description: Keir Starmer makes a rare visit to China as the world order appears to shift further away from Trump and the US, writes Krishnan Guru-Murthy in Beijing.

item.title: UK-China Deal: Is Starmer choosing Xi over Trump?
item.description: As Keir Starmer edges Britain closer to China as Trump continues to threaten and destabilise, are we watching the World Order being rewritten?

item.title: Is President Trump turning countries towards China?
item.description: From Europe, or what Donald Trump described as a 'decaying' group of countries, with 'weak' leaders - to the United States.

item.title: How do people in Britain view the new world order?
item.description: We commissioned a poll to find out how people in Britain view the changing world order, and its impact on the UK's relations with China, Nato, the US and EU.

item.title: 12-year-old girl strangled and raped in Nuneaton, court told
item.description: A 12-year-old girl has described in court how a man accused of raping her laughed as she pleaded with him to stop.

item.title: ‘China and the UK have to work together’ – China expert Henry Wang
item.description: We spoke to founder of the think tank the Centre for China and Globalisation, Henry Wang, which advises the Chinese government.

item.title: Starmer’s visit in China is ‘historic’ says Chinese journalist
item.description: We’re joined by Zichen Wang, who is the founder and editor of the English-language politics and business newsletter Pekingnology.

item.title: ‘Collaborate, compete, confront’: Europe’s changing relationship with China
item.description: What are the fears that Europeans have about security in the new world order, particularly when Russia and China seem to walk ever closer?

item.title: Threat from China is ‘substantial’ says former head of CIA
item.description: We’re joined by retired US army general David Petraeus.

item.title: Why China’s tech dominance brings security concerns
item.description: China's not only an economic superpower - it's making rapid strides in advanced technology like AI and robotics.
